svg.title: This same majorant controls the test products after the prescribed finite Schwartz seminorms are taken. The normalized shrinking trace bump and its Fourier transform are retained exactly, with limit one and modulus at most one. Thus the ball-local reader recovers TR32 by dominated convergence, keeping each remote support and imposing no separation between different remote tests. The coherent-sector extraction below remains its explicit dependency. The two Fourier signs, electric factors and (−1)b in TR33 are unchanged scalar readouts. Con- sequently AZ b = Ab, BZ = Bb and T Z = Tb as continuous spatial distributions, with precisely b b the TR34 seminorm and its uniform derivative order. The time-bump derivatives retain their two factors (i|ki|)b and (−i|ki|)b. Their common dominated limit therefore transports point support without altering either frequency branch.
